_help: Edit only this file to add/change animations. Times in seconds, angles in degrees (positive = clockwise on screen). 'pose' lists only bones that differ from the bind pose (angles are ABSOLUTE local angles, rest = 0). Every frame starts from rest, it does not inherit the previous keyframe. A looping clip needs the SAME pose at its start and end times. Clip length * fps must be a whole number (fps=15). Clips must not overlap in time. Keep each clip to a few keyframes; rely on interpolation.
